name: Fujairah
summary: Fujairah, Day 241. The UAE's Gulf of Oman hub became Iran's target set: ~180–217 ships at anchor off Fujairah/Khor Fakkan (JMIC), a tug hit off Khor Fakkan (18 Oct), and the ship-to-ship transfer trade (~4 mb/d in mid-October, about half of Gulf of Oman crude) explicitly targeted, with STS volumes falling 2.2 mb/d. The bypass works for barrels but is now inside the war zone.

recent_signals.headline: Fujairah product stocks 11.414 mb (+2.5 mb) in the week to 2 Nov (FOIZ via an aggregator, REPORTED); not a throughput figure. Vortexa: the UAE's Gulf exports fell the most of any producer in October. Murban ~$0.80 below January Brent on 4 Nov (one print). (intel SAU-A7, MAC-A2)

No Fujairah-specific throughput figure found; UAE crude exports 3.74 mb/d in October (Bloomberg tanker tracking, REPORTED). No hit on the Fujairah/Khor Fakkan anchorages; two hits off Limah (1–2 Nov) are ~60–90 km north. (intel MAC-A2, KIN-A5)

No Fujairah throughput, turn-back or anchorage-incident report found 26–31 Oct. New risk: the first limpet attack (Louise 1, 29 Oct) — EOS warns ships at anchor face 'particular risk'; Louise 1 reportedly moved to an anchorage off Khor Fakkan; ~490 vessels wait outside the strait (JMIC 108, 25 Oct). The Gulf of Oman transfer trade (TD34 WS659) keeps Kpler's barrels moving. (REPORTED; intel KIN-B1/A4)

~180–217 ships at anchor off Fujairah/Khor Fakkan (JMIC, 15–18 Oct); a tug hit ~20 nm NE of Khor Fakkan (18 Oct) — the Gulf of Oman side; Khor Fakkan/Fujairah/Sohar STS ~3.97 mb/d (12–14 Oct, Windward), about half of Gulf of Oman crude, now Iran's stated target. No new VLCC turn-back report after Bloomberg's 12 Oct story. (REPORTED; intel KIN-A3/A5)

**Bypass hub under threat: ≥10 VLCCs and several Suezmaxes approaching Fujairah stopped or reversed course 'in recent days' as attacks reached UAE anchorages (Bloomberg, 12 Oct); JMIC warns of further strikes at UAE anchorages and in the southern Omani corridor.** Fujairah line at capacity ~1.8 mb/d (Argus). Gulf of Oman STS volumes ~12 mb/d (Clarksons). — REPORTED (Bloomberg tracking).

Hercules Star: one crew member killed and one missing after an incident off Dubai (9 Sep, Haaretz/Reuters); UAE trade with Iran halted since 18 Aug. Fujairah/UAE-side waters are inside Iran's declared 'restricted zone' (7 Sep). (Reuters; Sputnik — CONFIRMED incident)

**B3 MODI-MBZ FUJAIRAH EXPANSION ALTERNATIVE-ROUTE PLAN PUBLICLY DISCLOSED** (CONFIRMED — Business Standard, The Tribune, India TV, Khaleej Times, The National, DD News). India and UAE expected to sign two MoUs on LPG supplies and Strategic Petroleum Reserves. Alternatives explored: (a) Indian vessels loading more oil and LPG shipments from Port of Fujairah in Gulf of Oman, (b) expansion of Fujairah oil terminal capacity, (c) UAE laying additional cross-peninsula pipeline. **UAE Minister Sultan Al Jaber: 'energy has been weaponised by Hormuz being taken hostage effectively' = cleanest Gulf-state public language framing Hormuz situation as weaponisation by Iran.** **B1 HUI CHUAN SEIZED 38NM NE OF FUJAIRAH MAY 14** — Honduras-flagged, 'unauthorised personnel whilst at anchor,' reportedly bound for Iranian territorial waters (UKMTO primary CONFIRMED on event; REPORTED on destination; NO claim of responsibility).
